description_for_human: Free MCP server for AI agents. Check domain availability, compare prices, look up registration info, and estimate domain value.
description_for_model: Donadomains exposes a free Model Context Protocol server. Connect from any MCP-aware client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Claude.ai Connectors, Cursor, Continue, Windsurf, Zed) by adding {"type":"http","url":"https://www.donadomains.xyz/api/mcp"} to the mcpServers config. Tools: check_domain_availability(domain) returns availability + price OR ownership info; search_domains(keyword, limit?, tldFilter?, includeTaken?) returns available domains with prices; get_domain_info(domain) returns detailed registration info for any TLD; valuate_domain(domain, registered?, isPremium?, registrationPrice?) returns AI-powered USD valuation with reasoning. Free, no API key, rate-limited per IP.
